run_create_finetune_dataset: run the CLI script to convert ASE atoms files into ASE database datasets for finetuning
launch_processing: launch parallel processing to convert ASE atoms files into an ASE database with metadata
compute_normalizer_and_linear_reference: compute force RMS normalizer and linear reference coefficients from a training ASE database
compute_lin_ref: compute linear reference coefficients from atomic numbers and energies using least squares regression
write_ase_db: write ASE atoms objects with energy and force results to an ASE database file in parallel
